title: Impulse Space mission index
description: A black band: a 40px heading with a short lede and an outline pill, then a full-bleed frame nearly a window tall whose photo settles from a 1.23× zoom to full size as it scrolls into view. Over a bottom-up dark gradient sits a list of mission names at 50% white with mono details; hovering one wipes it to full white from the left and fades that mission's own photo into the frame.
notes: the frame is sized by the window (100svh less 38px); photos are cropped like object-fit: cover
a .dark scope: always black with white text
CSS only: the zoom is a scroll-driven animation (static in browsers without it, and with reduced motion); each mission may bring its own photo, shown while it is hovered
